fallacy_scan.name: Simpson's paradox
fallacy_scan.action: Micro, equal-entity and exact shared-entity decomposition are separately reported.

fallacy_scan.name: Ecological fallacy
fallacy_scan.action: Per-example paired errors do not identify personal/entity causal effects.

fallacy_scan.name: Non-collapsibility
fallacy_scan.action: No odds ratios or nonlinear regression coefficients are interpreted.

fallacy_scan.name: Confounding
fallacy_scan.action: Component active capacity differs; external campaign/source/runtime differs. Histories and regimes are descriptive controls, not causal adjustment.

fallacy_scan.name: Base rate neglect
fallacy_scan.action: Every group reports n and population contribution; conditional error is not substituted for the global contribution.

fallacy_scan.name: Regression to the mean
fallacy_scan.action: Worst-entity ranks are posthoc descriptions with no improvement or independent replication claim.

fallacy_scan.name: Survivorship bias
fallacy_scan.action: Only complete, approved 72 fixed fits with exact populations enter; all 216 model/split rows are required.

fallacy_scan.name: Look-elsewhere effect
fallacy_scan.action: All seven pairs and declared partitions are retained; no formal significance claim or favorable slice-only conclusion.

fallacy_scan.name: Garden of forking paths
fallacy_scan.action: Exploratory diagnostics after Test exposure; no new thresholds, checkpoint selection, fitting or exclusions.

fallacy_scan.name: Correlation versus causation
fallacy_scan.action: Arithmetic attribution and observed associations do not prove loss/GRU/distribution causal mechanisms.

fallacy_scan.name: Reverse causality
fallacy_scan.action: History fields precede targets; target-relative strata are outcome-conditioned diagnostics, not predictors available before the target.

limitations: Fixed-model Train errors are in-sample diagnostic errors, not an independent generalization estimate.
No new checkpoint selection, thresholds, model fitting, correction or Test-driven architecture choice is performed.
Quantity/target-to-history strata use the observed target and cannot be inference-time model-selection rules.
Raw Train/Validation/Test populations differ in quantity severity, date and eligible target composition; raw gaps alone do not prove overfitting.
A lower fixed-model log loss and higher raw RMSE reveals an objective/metric tradeoff but does not prove that changing loss would repair it.
CNN+GRU and CNN have different active parameter counts; this experiment cannot separate GRU design from model capacity or optimization effects.
External comparisons share frozen targets and quantity heads but differ in historical source/campaign/runtime; this is not a fresh same-runtime architecture experiment.
Intermittent seeds42/52 use native5090/cuDNN92000 and seed62 native5080/cuDNN91900; paired component arms match within seed but cross-seed runtimes differ.
Taxi and Intermittent chronological splits are entity-relative and have overlapping global calendar ranges, so common-calendar future deployment is not established.
This Test has prior access history; exploratory diagnoses and top-entity ranks are not independent confirmatory evidence.
Arithmetic membership/weight/within-entity attribution includes different targets and histories inside each entity and is not a causal decomposition.
Existing external Test rows do not contain original log-space model losses; those fields remain N/A rather than being replaced by a loss derived from raw predictions.
